title: Agent harness feeds
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for continuously researching, benchmarking and encapsulating updates on open agent harnesses (Harness Square / Harness2, OpenCode, Pi and Muse Code) with HarnessTax token overhead, cost-per-verified-task, Terminal-Bench and SWE-bench normalization, MCP tool reliability, freshness decay and Pareto selection.
boundaries: feed.agent-harnesses encapsulates child profiles, sources, benchmarks and Pareto recommendations by SHA-256 digest without granting execution authority.
schedule.harness-feed-scan is not_activated with authority: none; only an authorized schedule service may enqueue recurring refreshes.
Made-up benchmark numbers in worked examples test normalization and Pareto math and are never presented as live leaderboard results.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for continuously researching, benchmarking and encapsulating updates on open agent harnesses

value.lets_workers: Probe public release streams for Harness Square / Harness2, OpenCode, Pi and Muse Code, normalize Terminal-Bench and SWE-bench runs with HarnessTax token overhead, cost-per-verified-task and MCP reliability Wilson intervals, apply release-aware freshness decay, seal child task objects into a single encapsulated Feed digest, and select Pareto-optimal harnesses under explicit task constraints.

flow.when: Fetch upstream release tags and benchmark disclosures for the four tracked harnesses.
Compute HarnessTax, cost-per-verified-task and MCP reliability intervals.
Evaluate exponential age and missed-release decay across profiles and scores.
Seal updated child objects into feed.agent-harnesses with a canonical SHA-256 digest.
Rank non-dominated Pareto harnesses under token, cost and MCP reliability constraints.

value.worked_example: Made-up 4-harness evaluation across Harness Square / Harness2, OpenCode, Pi and Muse Code recomputed in test_harness_feeds.py: identifies [harness-square, muse-code, pi] on the Pareto frontier and seals 7 child task objects into a canonical SHA-256 feed digest.

nouns.title: Guardrail: report HarnessTax token overhead and cost-per-verified-task alongside raw accuracy
nouns.category_reason: Prevents bloated retry loops from masking token and latency overhead behind headline solve rates.

value.rule: Every normalized harness benchmark reports HarnessTax ((total_harness_tokens - raw_task_tokens) / raw_task_tokens), cost_per_verified_task_usd and MCP tool call reliability alongside solve_rate, and requires model_id, harness_version, suite_id and timeout_s for setup_complete.
value.how_it_is_checked: normalize_harness_benchmark computes all four dimensions and marks incomplete disclosures setup_complete: false so pareto_frontier excludes them.

nouns.title: Guardrail: the Feed task object encapsulates child profiles, sources, benchmarks and recommendations by digest
nouns.category_reason: Ensures consumers read a consistent, order-independent snapshot across all tracked harnesses.

value.rule: feed.agent-harnesses pins every child profile, source, benchmark matrix and Pareto recommendation and records encapsulate_feed's canonical SHA-256 digest.
value.how_it_is_checked: test_harness_feeds.py recomputes encapsulate_feed in forward and reversed child order and asserts byte-identical feed_digest_sha256.

nouns.title: Guardrail: schedule proposals carry zero authority until activated by an authorized service

value.rule: schedule.harness-feed-scan remains activation: not_activated and authority: none; importing or reading the pack starts no cron or background poller.
value.how_it_is_checked: tests/test_packs.py verifies activation == not_activated and allowed enqueue verb categories.

nouns.title: Harness profile: Harness Square / Harness2
nouns.category_reason: Captures the loop architecture, sandbox model and MCP capabilities of an agent harness.

value.loop_architecture: Typed two-stage task graph with isolated sandbox execution, explicit context checkpoints and deterministic verification gates.
value.mcp_support: Native stdio and streamable HTTP MCP client with schema pinning and retry budgets.

nouns.title: Harness profile: OpenCode
nouns.category_reason: Captures the terminal coding loop, provider routing and MCP capabilities of OpenCode.

value.loop_architecture: Terminal-first coding agent CLI and TUI with provider-agnostic model routing, LSP diagnostics and session diffs.
value.mcp_support: Configurable local and remote MCP server tools alongside shell and patch primitives.
strengths: Broad open-weight and hosted model compatibility

nouns.title: Harness profile: Pi
nouns.category_reason: Captures the minimal low-HarnessTax loop and on-demand MCP bridge architecture of Pi.

value.loop_architecture: Minimalist low-overhead coding harness emphasizing lean system prompts, direct bash/edit primitives and low HarnessTax.
value.mcp_support: Lightweight skill and MCP bridge extensions on demand so idle tools do not bloat prompt tokens.

nouns.title: Harness profile: Muse Code
nouns.category_reason: Captures the multi-pass plan-and-review editing loop and MCP capabilities of Muse Code.

value.loop_architecture: Collaborative multi-pass repository editing and review harness pairing plan synthesis with patch verification.
value.mcp_support: Structured MCP tool invocation with workspace-scoped read/write boundaries.

nouns.title: Public release and benchmark channels for Harness Square / Harness2, OpenCode, Pi and Muse Code
nouns.category_reason: Lists upstream public release feeds and benchmark boards monitored for harness updates.

watched_targets.channel: public git tags and benchmark manifests
public CLI package releases and minimal-agent benchmarks
public release notes and repository evaluation harness

nouns.title: Made-up normalized benchmark matrix across Harness Square / Harness2, OpenCode, Pi and Muse Code
nouns.category_reason: Normalized evaluation run recording solve_rate, HarnessTax, cost_per_verified_task_usd and MCP reliability.

nouns.title: Pareto frontier and constrained harness selection recomputed from benchmark.normalized-matrix
nouns.category_reason: Records non-dominated Pareto frontier IDs and utility-ranked harness choices.

nouns.title: Encapsulated Feed task object: open agent harnesses, release streams, normalized benchmarks and Pareto rankings
nouns.category_reason: Encapsulates child profiles, release sources, benchmark matrices and Pareto recommendations into one digest-verified feed object.

nouns.title: Proposed daily agent harness feed scan and freshness check (not activated)
nouns.category_reason: A schedule proposal is stored as a seed hypothesis, following the library's unactivated schedule precedent.

value.activation_path: Recurring execution needs Tessera's flag-gated schedule support, which is being designed now. No scheduler is activated by this pack, and a schedule noun cannot authorize work by itself.

cadence.start_reason: Set by the owner when an authorized schedule adapter exists.

value.enqueue_identity: SHA-256 of the schedule key, its version and the window start, so duplicate ticks never create duplicate tasks.
value.missed_windows: Skip missed windows; never catch up more than one window.
value.follow_up: recheck-harness-freshness proposes normalize-harness-benchmarks when new release tags or benchmark trials arrive; an authorized requester enqueues those.

nouns.title: Tool card: agent harness feed normalizer, Pareto ranker and digest encapsulator
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python standard-library package pinned by path, file count and digest.

value.name: agent harness feeds
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
commands: python -m harness_feeds freshness --observed YYYY-MM-DD --as-of YYYY-MM-DD [--missed-releases N]
does: Computes HarnessTax token overhead, cost-per-verified-task and Wilson 95 percent intervals.
Finds non-dominated Pareto frontiers and ranks harnesses under budget, HarnessTax and MCP reliability constraints.
Computes exponential freshness decay and deterministic SHA-256 encapsulated feed digests.
does_not: Activate a scheduler, scrape private endpoints, execute arbitrary untrusted harness binaries or fabricate live leaderboard claims.

nouns.title: Template: encapsulated agent harness feed snapshot summary

value.describes: an encapsulated agent harness feed summary recording child count, canonical SHA-256 feed digest, Pareto frontier IDs and recommended harness

nouns.title: Worked example input: made-up raw benchmark runs for Harness Square / Harness2, OpenCode, Pi and Muse Code
nouns.category_reason: Made-up trial inputs from which test_harness_feeds.py recomputes normalization, Pareto frontier and feed digest.

verbs.title: Probe public release streams and changelogs for tracked agent harnesses
verbs.summary: Read public release tags, changelogs and benchmark manifest digests for Harness Square / Harness2, OpenCode, Pi and Muse Code without posting or modifying anything upstream.
verbs.outcome: Observed release versions, commit digests and timestamped source records.

slots.name: source_catalog
slots.description: Pin of the public harness release source catalog.

network: Conditional GET with ETag or If-Modified-Since against allowlisted public release endpoints only; do not write or authenticate.
steps: Fetch release tags and dates for each target in source.open-harness-releases using read-only GET requests.
Record version strings, commit hashes and missed-release counts since the current feed snapshot.

acceptance.check: Observations cover harness-square, opencode, pi and muse-code or record an explicit fetch error.

verbs.title: Normalize Terminal-Bench and SWE-bench trials with HarnessTax and MCP reliability
verbs.summary: Compute HarnessTax token overhead, cost-per-verified-task, solve rate Wilson 95 percent intervals, MCP tool call reliability and setup completeness across harness trials.
verbs.outcome: A normalized benchmark matrix ready for Pareto ranking.

slots.name: raw_harness_runs
slots.description: Pin of raw benchmark trial counts, token totals, costs and MCP tool call counts.

steps: Run python -m harness_feeds normalize on the raw trial records.
Flag any run missing model_id, harness_version, suite_id or timeout_s as setup_complete: false.

acceptance.check: normalize_harness_benchmark reproduces solve_rate, harness_tax_ratio, cost_per_verified_task_usd and mcp_reliability.

verbs.title: Recheck freshness decay and release drift across harness profiles and benchmarks
verbs.summary: Evaluate exponential age decay and missed-release penalties on each harness profile and benchmark matrix, marking aging or stale entries for re-evaluation.
verbs.outcome: Freshness scores and staleness flags per harness.

slots.name: current_feed
slots.description: Pin of the current encapsulated harness feed.

steps: Run compute_freshness_decay for each child profile and benchmark observation date against as_of_date.
Propose normalize-harness-benchmarks whenever status is aging or stale.

acceptance.check: compute_freshness_decay reproduces freshness_score and status for every entry.

verbs.title: Encapsulate child profiles, sources, benchmarks and recommendations into one Feed digest
verbs.summary: Verify all four required open harness profiles are present, compute individual child SHA-256 digests, and seal them into a canonical encapsulated Feed snapshot.
verbs.outcome: A conforming feed-snapshot summary and updated feed.agent-harnesses record.

slots.name: normalized_matrix
slots.description: Pin of the normalized benchmark matrix.

slots.name: pareto_recommendation
slots.description: Pin of the Pareto frontier recommendation.

steps: Run encapsulate_feed over the four harness profiles, release sources, normalized matrix and Pareto recommendation.
Validate the snapshot summary against template.feed-snapshot.

acceptance.check: encapsulate_feed produces the exact encapsulated_digest_sha256 regardless of input list order.

verbs.title: Select a Pareto-optimal agent harness under cost, HarnessTax and MCP floors
verbs.summary: Filter normalized harness benchmarks by setup completeness, cost ceiling, HarnessTax ceiling and MCP reliability floor, compute the four-objective Pareto frontier, and return the ranked recommendation.
verbs.outcome: Selected harness ID, Pareto frontier list, ranked utilities and rejection reasons.

slots.name: feed_snapshot
slots.description: Pin of the encapsulated agent harness feed.

steps: Run select_harness with the requester's max_cost_per_verified_usd, max_harness_tax_ratio and min_mcp_reliability.
Record both ranked eligible harnesses and explicit rejection reasons for filtered candidates.

acceptance.check: select_harness reproduces pareto_frontier, selected_harness_id and rejected reasons.
